name: Sugal Earthen Spaces Ventures Limited
about: Sugal Earthen Spaces Ventures Limited provides share broking services in India. It operates in two segments, Share Brokering and Real Estate. The company offers equity and derivatives, equities trading, futures and options (F&O) trading, depository services, mutual funds, government securities, IPOs, and online trading services, as well as wealth management services. It is also involved in the buying, selling, and dealing in shares and other securities in the secondary markets; development and sale of plotted land; layout development; and villa projects. The company was formerly known as Sugal & Damani Share Brokers Limited and changed its name to Sugal Earthen Spaces Ventures Limited in April 2026. Sugal Earthen Spaces Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Chennai, India.
